explication: WireGuard for iOS and macOS manages WireGuard tunnel configurations and VPN operation. Users import or scan a configuration, review or edit it, save it as a managed tunnel, then activate it and inspect status or runtime details. The manager coordinates tunnel lifecycle with the system Network Extension; WireGuardKit configures the packet tunnel and the Go-backed engine. The tree documents ZIP import/export, on-demand rules, and logs as additional capabilities. Sampled excerpts are partial, so uncertain internal wiring is omitted.
